We are a team of over 500 talented individuals, spanning more than 30 functions and areas of expertise, and representing over 40 nationalities. Together, we bring diverse perspectives and professional backgrounds to help shape the future of healthcare through innovation and technology. This is your opportunity to explore a world of possibilities across areas such as Data & Analytics, Digital, Technology & Innovation, Cybersecurity, R&D Operations, Global Distribution, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, General & Administrative, Human Resources, and many more. Located in the heart of Lisbon, our AMGEN office fosters a culture of innovation, excellence, and purpose. Come thrive with us at AMGEN, supporting our mission To Serve Patients. What we do at AMGEN matters in people’s lives. CUSTOMER FINANCE INTERN (FRENCH SPEAKING) LIVE WHAT YOU WILL DO As a Customer Finance Intern you will gain hands-on experience supporting key financial operations that help ensure the smooth delivery of our medicines to patients around the world. Working closely with Customer Finance professionals, internal stakeholders, and external customers, you will develop valuable expertise in accounts receivable, cash collections, credit management, and financial processes. This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced international environment while building a strong foundation for a future career in Finance. Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will: Cash collections & receivables support – Assist with cash collection activities, monitor outstanding balances, support cash application processes, and help ensure financial records are maintained accurately and in compliance with company policies. Credit & risk management – Support customer credit reviews, monitor credit limits, analyse customer financial information, and contribute to effective credit risk management across assigned markets. Financial operations excellence – Help maintain accurate customer master data, support accounts receivable reconciliations, record transactions in line with local and corporate requirements, and ensure data integrity across finance systems. Stakeholder collaboration – Partner with internal teams and external customers to resolve payment-related queries, gather cash forecast information, and support daily Customer Finance activities. Continuous improvement & global teamwork – Contribute ideas to streamline processes, leverage finance tools and systems effectively, provide support across the team when needed, and collaborate with colleagues from diverse international backgrounds while developing your professional skills. WIN WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU Minimum requirements University Degree in Finance, Economy or similar Knowledge of basic principles, methods, and practices of professional field of Customer Finance and Accounts Receivables. Fluency in English and French Preferred requirements SAP Knowledge Office Programs (Excel, PowerPoint) knowledge THRIVE WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT OF US As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also care deeply for our teammates’ well-being and growth. Vast opportunities to learn, develop, and move up and across our global organization. Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where colleagues are empowered to bring ideas to the table, take risks, and act. Generous AMGEN Total Rewards Plan comprising healthcare, finance, wealth, and career benefits. Flexible work arrangements. APPLY NOW Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.
